Commentary.Commentary: DAVID MILLER is the next man in.
OUT! LBW! Zampa strikes!
Landed around off, Rossouw defends it from within his crease.
On the pads, turning in, Duminy tries to work but misses and gets hit on the pads. The umpire turns down the appeal and the batsmen take a leg bye. Replays show it was pitching outside leg.
Loopy on off, Duminy pushes it back to the bowler.
Good length ball outside off, JP pushes it through covers off his back foot for a single to end the over.
Length ball around off, angling across, Rossouw gets an outside edge towards third man as he tries to push. Single taken.
Short of a length ball on middle and off, Duminy pulls it to deep mid-wicket. Head covers good distance and keeps the batsmen down to three runs.
Landed outside off, Duminy drives it towards short extra cover.
Fuller length ball on off, Duminy drives it towards mid on.
Fullish on off, Rossouw lofts it over the bowler's head for a single.

Appeal for an LBW! On the pads, Duminy tries to paddle but the ball probably goes off the pads towards fine leg. There is an appeal for a leg before but the umpire says no. The batsmen take a couple. Runs given!
Short ball on middle and off, Rossouw pulls it through square leg for a single.
On middle and off, Duminy lofts it over wide mid on for a single.
Fullish on middle and leg, Rossouw flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
On middle and leg, Duminy works it through the leg side for a couple.
Adam Zampa is back.
Banged in short on middle and leg, Rossouw does well to evade it.
JP DUMINY walks in next.

OUT! WHAT A CATCH! Short of a length ball on middle and leg, de Kock tries to pull but gets a big top edge. The ball flies high up in the air and Daniel Worrall keeps his eye on the ball throughout, gets under the ball near fine leg and takes a terrific catch. That's a big wicket for Australia as the in-form de Kock is out.
On the pads, Rossouw works it to short fine leg and takes a quick single.

Superb fielding! Short of a length ball outside off, Rossouw rides on the bounce and cuts it over the point region. Finch runs in hard in the deep and dives forward to stop the ball. Just two runs taken. Excellent stop!
Another play and a miss! This is good bowling. Tremain takes off the pace a bit, bowls a length delivery outside off, Rossouw tries to push but fails to put his bat on the ball.
Length ball outside off, Rossouw tries to push but fails to put his bat on the ball. The keeper fumbles a bit too behind.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. The batsmen have run through for a single.
FOUR! Poor ball! Short outside off, Rossouw punches it away through the extra cover region. The ball races away to the fence in no time.
Landed outside off, de Kock pushes it through covers for a single.
Shortish on off, Rossouw punches it through cover-point for a single again.
Tad short outside off, de Kock punches it through point for a single.
Fullish ball on off, Rossouw drives it towards long off for a single.

In the air... but safe! Short of a length ball on middle and off, de Kock is a bit early onto his pull shot now. The ball flies high up in the air and lands safely near deep mid-wicket. Two runs taken.
On middle and leg, Rossouw works it through the leg side for a single. 150 up for South Africa!
Fuller length ball around off, Rossouw drives it back to the bowler.
Around off, de Kock taps it to mid off for a quick single.
Length ball outside off, Rilee pushes it through covers for a single.
Short of a length ball on off, Rossouw goes for the pull but he's a bit early onto his shot. The ball goes off the bottom edge to the keeper behind.
Chris Tremain back on.
FOUR! Lovely shot, poor ball! Full toss on middle and leg, de Kock sweeps it nicely through the square leg for a boundary. He is batting really well.
Driven through mid off by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Landed around off, de Kock drives it through mid on for a run.
Full around off, Rossouw drives it through mid off for a single to get off the mark.
RILEE ROSSOUW is the next man in.

OUT! DU PLESSIS HOLES OUT! Head drags it short on middle and off, du Plessis goes onto his back foot quickly and pulls it away to the leg side. The ball goes high up in the air and for a moment it looks like it's going over the fence but it goes straight into the hands of David Warner at deep mid-wicket. Travis Head gets the wicket of the South African captain! A very good partnership comes to an end. South Africa lose their second wicket, need 232 runs from 196 balls.
Full ball around off, Quinton drills it through mid on for a single.
DRINKS BREAK!
On middle and leg, QdK works it through square leg for a single to end the over.
Short ball on middle and leg, du Plessis pulls it through mid-wicket for a single.
Full ball outside off, du Plessis drives it to covers.
Landed around off, driven through mid on for a single.
DROPPED! Fullish outside off, du Plessis drives it uppishly to covers where Smith jumps but fails to grab it. He tried his best there actually. du Plessis gets a life and a single as well.
Landed around off, Faf pushes it towards point.
Full on off, driven through mid off for a single.
The batsman has edged that one. Two runs added to the total.
Full outside off, de Kock drives it through covers for a single as Warner quickly collects the ball in the deep.
SIX! That's a huge six! Head drags it short and de Kock quickly goes onto his back foot to pull it over the mid-wicket region. The ball lands into the crowd and de Kock gets another six.
On middle an off, de Kock works it to mid-wicket.
8th ODI fifty for Quinton de Kock!

FOUR! Even Head is greeted with a boundary! Fullish on the pads, de Kock sweeps it towards the long leg region. The ball goes past the fence and de Kock brings up his fifty as well. He is in top form here.
Travis Head to bowl his offies.
Flatter and shorter on off, cut through point for a couple. 13 runs off the over!
Driven through mid on by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Googly on off, du Plessis goes back and punches it to covers for one.
50-run stand comes up!
FOUR! Once again Zampa is on the shorter side with his length, lands it on middle, du Plessis goes deep inside the crease and spanks it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Drags his length short and lands it on middle, de Kock goes deep inside the crease and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Mid off drops back.
FOUR! The leggie is greeted with a superb boundary! A flighted full ball outside off, de Kock gets on the front foot and drills it through the gap between short cover and mid off for a boundary.
Adam Zampa is introduced into the attack.
The batsman has played it to the point region. No run.
FOUR! Boom! Back of a length ball on off, du Plessis gets on top of the bounce and pulls it powerfully over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Fuller in length and angling into the batsman, slower in pace, du Plessis moves back a bit and pushes it with an inside half of the bat to mid on.
Driven through the covers by the batsman. They pick up a single.
SIX! High and handsome! Marsh puts it on a fuller length outside off and offers plenty of width, de Kock latches onto it and sends it packing over long off for a biggie.
Lands it on a length and outside off, du Plessis taps it to covers and crosses for a run.
Length ball angling into the batsman, de Kock turns inside the crease with the pull shot but fails to connect.
Stays back footed to a length ball and punches it down to long off for one.
On a length around middle, nipping in a shade, du Plessis tries to defend but misses and is hit on the back leg.
Change of pace, slower through the air and it's full outside off, de Kock runs it down off the outside half of the bat to third man. They pick up a single.
Back of a length ball on off, it's punched to sweeper cover for a single.
Hastings goes wide of the crease and angles in a full ball on off, du Plessis pushes it from the crease to covers.
On a length and outside off, angling in, Faf easily runs it down to third man for a single.
Back of a length ball on off, pulling his pace back a bit, du Plessis goes back and punches it towards mid off.
Lands it on a fuller length ball outside off, de Kock shuffles across the stumps a bit and then drives it through covers for one.
FOUR! Superb shot! Slants in a fuller length ball on off, slower in pace, de Kock picks it up early and swings it over mid-wicket for a cracking boundary.
Fullish and angling into the right-hander this time, it's driven on the up through covers for a run.
Angles in a full length ball from around the wicket, de Kock forces it through covers for a single.
Mitchell Marsh to have a bowl.
Slower length ball outside off, Faf taps it down to point and looks for a run. Turned down by his partner.
FOUR! Well played! Back of a length ball on off, du Plessis stands inside the crease and whacks it past the diving point fielder for a boundary. Bailey in the deep had no chance of cutting it off!
Digs in a short ball outside off, de Kock stands tall and slaps it to deep point for one.
On a length outside off, du Plessis hangs back and pushes it off the bottom half of the bat through covers for a single.
Shortish and on off, punched to sweeper cover for one.
Full in length and outside off, du Plessis drives it through covers for a single.
Powerplay 2 time!
Fullish and on middle, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Beautiful timing! A good length ball on off, du Plessis camps back and punches it sweetly through cover-point for a boundary.
Extra bounce on this occasion from a length around off, Faf is taken by surprise and he takes his bottom hand off the handle in defense.
Lands it on a full length around off, du Plessis goes back and punches it straight to Bailey at cover-point.
Gets behind the line of a fuller length ball and pushes it to mid on.
Puts it on a fuller length around off, it's defended off the front foot by Faf.
Wide! Full in length and sliding down the leg side, du Plessis tries to flick but misses.

FOUR! Well played! Short of a length ball on off, de Kock goes deep inside the crease with the square cut and delays his shot just a bit to get the placement right through the gap between short third man and backward point.
Good length ball angling into the batsman, de Kock defends it off his pads to the leg side.
Fuller in length on middle, it's driven through mid on for a single. Gets off the mark first ball.
Skipper Faf du Plessis is the new batsman.

OUT! Amla is adjudged lbw! Hastings angles in a full length ball around off, Amla shuffles across the stumps and tries to heave it over the leg side. But he fails to make any connection and is hit on the pads. They appeal and the umpire raises his finger after thinking for a while. Amla has a little chat with his partner but de Kock feels he is out and hence asks not to take the DRS. Hashim departs after playing a scintillating knock. The replays show that the impact was with the umpire's call. So, it indeed was a good call to not waste a review. 306 needed off 249 balls.
Short and wide outside off, slapped past point for one.
Pitches it full and outside off, de Kock drives it through covers for a couple of runs.
FOUR! This time it's very full in length by Worrall, too straight in line as well, Amla whips it through mid-wicket for a boundary.

FOUR! Up and over! Amla was not in control of that shot! Worrall delivers a shortish ball outside off, Amla tries to hit it through the line but ends up slicing it off the outside half of the bat. The bottom hand comes off the handle but it still has enough to fly over cover-point for a boundary.
Fuller in length and on middle, flicked on the leg side but straight to Head at short mid-wicket.
Worrall comes from around the wicket for the left-hander and angles in a full ball on middle, de Kock nudges it to mid-wicket and crosses.
A touch short and outside off, Amla cuts it off his back foot through backward point for a single.
Play and a miss! On a length and outside off, skidding through the surface, Amla clears his front leg and tries to go big down the ground but fails to make any connection.
Stays back to a shortish ball and punches it to covers. The fielder makes a tumbling stop and they cross for a single.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot but fails to find the gap on the leg side.
Played to the point region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Smart batting. Quietly runs a length ball down to third man for a single.
FOUR! Another boundary from the bat of Amla. He is batting in top gear at the moment. Receives a shortish ball in his half and he mercilessly pulls it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
FOUR! Poor start from Hastings, he bowls a length delivery wide outside off, plenty of width on offer and Amla slaps it over covers for a boundary.

Beaten all ends up! Brilliant bowling by Worrall! He gets a shortish ball to nip back into the batsman from around off, de Kock tries to push at it but misses. The ball beats the inside edge by a whisker.
On a length and outside off, Amla runs it down to third man for a run.
Angles in a length ball on off, de Kock closes the face of the bat early and gets a leading edge. It goes just wide of Warner at point and they pick up a single.
Brings a length ball back into the batsman, de Kock tries to work it on the leg side but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Width on offer outside off, de Kock goes hard at it and it goes off the outside half of the bat to short third man.
Beaten! Worrall continues from around the wicket and lands a length ball outside off, it straightens a touch after landing, Quinton feels for it and gets beaten.
On the pads again, this time Amla fails to make any use of it. Ends up nudging it straight to short fine leg.

FOUR! Boom, Amla is on fire! Fetches a shortish ball from outside off and powers it over mid-wicket for a cracking boundary. South Africa are off to a flier! Five boundaries in last six balls for Hashim!
FOUR! Wrong line by Tremain, he bowls a full length ball on the pads and Amla sweetly tucks it through backward square leg for a boundary.
Another play and a miss! Good length ball outside off, Amla gets across the stumps and tries to punch it through covers but fails to make any connection.
Play and a miss! On a length and wide outside off, Amla swishes and misses.
Back of a length delivery outside off, de Kock stands tall and punches it to point where Warner makes a good diving stop. They cross for a run.
FOUR! Three in a row and the Mighty Hash is motoring now! Worrall lands it on a length and outside off, Amla middles his punch shot to perfection and pierces the gap at covers for a boundary.

FOUR! Misfield by Warner! Fuller in length and outside off, Amla drives it off his front foot to point where Warner gets down low to stop the ball but it goes under his fingers and races away to the fence.
FOUR! Full in length and outside off, Amla shuffles across the stumps and eases it off his pads to the fine leg fence.
Full in length and outside off, pushed off the back foot to the off side.
Full and outside off, it's sliced past point for a single.

In the air... safe and there is a run out chance missed. Good length ball angling into the batsman, Amla tries to turn it on the leg side but it takes the leading edge and goes aerially towards mid off. They set off for a single and Amla makes it safely to the other end as Finch misses his shy at the bowler's end.
Fuller length ball on the pads, flicked through mid-wicket and Zampa gave the chase from the circle. The batsmen crossed for a couple of runs.
Fuller length ball angling down the leg side, it's eased through square leg for a single.
Driven through mid on by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Good length ball on off, it's defended off the back foot.
Straying down the leg side, flicked through square leg for a single.
Full and angling into the batsman from around the wicket, de Kock tries to flick but gets a little leading edge through the gap at covers for one.

Appeal for an lbw! Worrall gets a length ball to nip back into the batsman and de Kock fails to work it around. He is hit on the pads, they appeal as the batsmen cross. It's given as a run so maybe there was some inside edge.
Worrall comes from around the wicket for the left-hander and angles in a full ball on off, de Kock gets forward and defends it towards mid on.
Good length ball on middle and leg, Amla glances it through square leg for a single.
Shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Full in length and outside off, Amla drives it off his front foot to covers.
Good start, on a length and outside off, hint of away shape, Amla covers the line and shoulders arms.
Daniel Worrall to bowl from the other end.
Length ball on off, Amla tucks it through square leg for a single.
Angles in a full ball on middle, it's pushed off the pads to mid on.
Full and wide outside off, driven through covers for one. Smith has given a sweeper on the off side to Tremain.

Almost a run out! Full length ball outside off, de Kock drives it through covers and they attempt for the second run. The fielder from the deep fires in a throw at the bowler's end and Amla running to that side has his bat stuck inside the turf. In case of a direct hit, it would have been an unfortunate run out.
Wide! Slips a length ball down the leg side.
FOUR! Brilliant timing! Tremain pitches it full and outside off, de Kock unfurls a beautiful cover drive and finds the gap for a boundary. He is away!
Fuller length ball wide outside off, de Kock reaches out for it and pushes it to covers.

Back for the chase. The men concerned are back on the field. Quinton de Kock and Hashim Amla are the South African openers as Rilee Rossouw drops down the order to accommodate the Mighty Hash. It will be Chris Tremain to begin proceedings with a slip in place. Here we go...
